messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · unshipped line carries no ship date and the order is months old

Part of it is already there. Your WXM WS2000 weather station was delivered July 20, tracking here: (tracking link hidden)

The O. Bundle on the order hasn't shipped, and I don't have a ship date for it, which isn't good enough given you ordered in June. I've pinged Abel and Georges to get the real date on it. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here, and if you step away you'll get it by email.
The weather station never arrived and shipping service sent back to original sender
Handed to the team · carrier returned the delivered-marked shipment to sender; needs reship or refund

Sorry, that's a bad run for one order. A unit that goes back to the sender needs the warehouse to confirm it landed and then send it out again, so I've put both things in front of Abel and Georges: the weather station and the date on the Overclocking Bundle.

Is the (address hidden) address still the right one to send it to, or has that changed?

Stay in the chat, one of them will jump in here. If you step away you'll get it by email.

Got it, I've added that to the note for them, same (address hidden) address.

Nothing else needed from you. Hang tight here and Abel or Georges will come back with the reship and the bundle date.
Thank you so much for your help 😄
Anytime. Sorry again for the runaround on this one. Keep an eye on this chat, or your inbox if you head off.
It’s fine I forgot about it for some time and probably should have reached out earlier

No harm done, it's on us to have caught it. A unit that bounces back should never sit quiet like that.

The team has everything they need, so it's just the wait for their reply now.
